_meta.source: Teks asli heartodex (descriptionOriginal di file data) dengan salah ketik yang jelas dibetulkan. descriptionOriginal tetap apa adanya.
_meta.translatedNote: Teks sumber entri ini bukan bahasa Inggris; yang ditampilkan adalah terjemahan Inggris buatan AI yang belum ditinjau.

apple-jam: Smooth yet pulpy with real apple chunks. Remember to close the lid snugly!
bizarre-food: It is obtained by cooking any food and failing.
bizzare-drink: It is obtained by preparing any beverage and failing.
black-truffle-pie: The jewel in the crown of mushroom pies, a real challenge for chefs' skills.
blue-roll-cake: With cyan sugar, it evokes verses such as «sky blue weeping woman».
blueberry-jam: Sweet with a rich blueberry aroma. Though dark like tar, it's said to benefit the eyes.
button-mushroom-pie: A cake with a creamy aroma, light as a cloud.
chocolate-sauce: Who said this is too sweet? This is the best chocolate sauce ever!
coffee: Savor the coffee carefully; aroma, sweetness, acidity, bitterness, and body in balance.
coffee-latte: Classic espresso and milk coffee, topped with foam art.
colorful-egg-feast: Look at all these stunning colorful eggs! If we save them only for celebration days, our cholesterol won't skyrocket, right?
egg: A natural and uncolored egg. Eating it won't truly bring you back to life, but it is undeniably delicious.
glasswort-shrimp-fried-rice: A quick low-fat, high-protein fried rice. Light eaters can skip the extra salt!
grape-jam: Stimulate the appetite and reduce fatigue. Being tasty is just a bonus.
grass-cake: A special treat from Green Green Grassland, sweet and delicious. It's what Paddi craves even in his dreams.
green-egg: A fresh green egg—might just vanish if hidden in the grass.
green-roll-cake: Matcha cake roll, tasty and never cloying.
grilled-button-mushroom: Like little bowls overflowing with juice. Be careful when eating them, they could burn your mouth!
grilled-mushrooms: Seasoned and roasted to perfection, the mushrooms become little golden, crispy “bombs” of freshness.
grilled-oyster-mushroom: Crispy and tasty, they taste best when the edges are golden brown and slightly curled.
grilled-penny-bun: Just a simple roasted mushroom? No: a delicacy on par with a steak!
grilled-shiitake-mushroom: With a cross marked on top that seals in the juices, full of flavor in every bite.
house-salad: A cold dish made with fresh vegetables and sauce. Just mix it up and dig in!
indigo-roll-cake: It smells like blue skies. The flower next to the cream is decorative, not edible!
mandarin-jam: The unique citrus flavor once made it a top choice for gifting.
mixed-jam: Varied fruits, diverse flavors. One single bite will fill you with pleasure.
mushroom-pie: A savory pie filled mainly with mushrooms, soft and full of flavor.
onsen-egg: Naughty says it's the perfect onsen egg, while the Traveling Gourmet calls it the worst. In a way, they both mean the same thing.
orange-egg: An egg bursting with passion. Wonder if your fingers will turn orange peeling it?
orange-roll-cake: Orange and puffy. Is it inspired by the morning glow?
original-roll-cake: Puffy cream topped with rainbow sugar, just like rainbow days in the town.
oyster-mushroom-pie: An oyster mushroom pie with a salty and intense flavor—its deliciousness is almost impossible to measure!
penny-bun-pie: With smoky notes of damp wood and a juicy flavor comparable to meat, it's a wonderful gift from the forest!
pineapple-jam: Preserved pineapple's unique aroma and tropical flavor. Remember to close the lid snugly!
purple-egg: An egg draped in royal purple. Even if it's just food coloring, please savor it with a solemn heart.
raspberry-jam: Red with a mildly tart flavor, leaving a lasting impression.
red-roll-cake: Strawberries and red sugar turn the cake pink, just like the evening glow in the town.
sea-grape-shiitake-chawanmushi: Silky steamed egg with shiitake mushrooms, topped with satisfyingly crunchy sea grapes - a match made in heaven!
shiitake-pie: A savory pie filled mainly with mushrooms, soft and full of flavor.
strawberry-jam: Turn strawberries into jam to enjoy the sweet and tart taste anytime.
tomato-sauce: Richly tangy. A must-have for seafood pizza.
violet-roll-cake: A purple cake like soft mist. It's sure to bring you sweet dreams.
wakame-meatball-soup: A simple, flavorful homestyle soup that's easy to make - just watch the portions, or the wakame might overflow the pot!
yellow-roll-cake: Yellow cream and cake, with a flavor as warm as the sun.
cheese-cake: A smooth and creamy dessert, served on a delicate plate with a milky aroma.
fish-and-chips: Boneless fried fish in crispy batter, served with hot chips. Classic.
smoked-fish-bagel: Mild smoked salmon, firm and flavorful bagel—a satisfying combination.
black-truffle-cream-pasta: A creamy black truffle sauce coats each noodle evenly, aromatic without being cloying.
rustic-ratatouille: Common ingredients such as tomatoes, potatoes, and lettuce, after unique preparation and seasoning, become a richly textured and beautifully presented dish.
seafood-risotto: Rice that is both soft and crispy, accompanied by fresh seafood.
meat-sauce-pasta: Easy and tasty, meat and tomato in sauce, topped with pasta and cheese.
seafood-pizza: Seafood paired with stretchy melted cheese delivers a rich, ocean-flavored taste.
apple-pie: Crunchy base with tender, sweet-and-sour apple—double the pleasure.
carrot-cake: Fresh carrots are carefully grated and blended into a fluffy cake base, offering a unique natural sweetness and wholesome nutrition.
corn-soup: Surrounded by the rich aroma of corn, every bite is a double delight for both the nose and the palate.
deluxe-seafood-platter: A seemingly ordinary seafood platter instantly becomes luxurious just by adding two crayfish.
tiramisu: A creative dessert, ladyfinger cookies instead of sponge cake.
afternoon-tea: Two small cakes accompanied by black tea, perfect for a relaxing afternoon.
picnic-set: It includes a variety of easy-to-carry, generous portions of food, perfect for sharing with friends in a scenic outdoor setting.
blue-european-crayfish-sashimi: A rarer and more expensive version of the Crayfish Sashimi, offering the most elevating taste experience.
crayfish-sashimi: A cold dish that preserves the lobster’s natural flavor to the fullest; fresh and delicious.
meat-burger: Junk food? It’s clearly the king of fast food, complete with meat, vegetables, and a staple all in one.
baked-eggplant-w-meat: Soft, tender eggplant coated in a savory meat sauce slow-simmered over low heat—perfect with rice!
candlelight-dinner: The ultimate expression of a romantic dinner—paired with a night view and soft, soothing music, it helps bring people closer together.
steamed-golden-king-crab: A prized ingredient like the Golden King Crab needs no complex preparation, its flavor speaks for itself.
steamed-king-crab: Even though it’s complicated to eat, many people still flock to this dish—that alone speaks for its deliciousness.
apple-milkshake: Chunks of fresh apple bring crunchiness to this milkshake.
blueberry-milkshake: Chunks of fresh blueberry bring freshness to this milkshake.
cocoa-milk-tea: A blend of cocoa powder and milk in the golden ratio, slightly sweeter than Mellow Milk Tea.
cocoa-milkshake: With just the right amount of cocoa powder, this classic combination rules the taste buds.
grape-milkshake: Chunks of fresh grape bring a honey-like sweetness to this milkshake.
matcha-milkshake: The right amount of matcha powder creates a deep, bittersweet and lingering flavor.
mellow-black-tea: Brewed from black tea leaves, featuring a bright red color and rich flavor with a slight hint of bitterness.
mellow-milk-tea: A blend of black tea and milk in the golden ratio, wrapped up in deliciousness.
milkshake: No water added, just four full boxes of milk blended into one pure milkshake.
pineapple-milkshake: Chunks of fresh pineapple bring tropical flavor to this milkshake.
raspberry-milkshake: Chunks of fresh raspberry bring tartness to this milkshake.
strawberry-milkshake: Chunks of fresh strawberry bring sweetness to this milkshake.
daisy-tea: With a few daisies in the brew, this golden tea soothes fevers and brightens the eyes.
exquisite-afternoon-tea: Bunny's so cute... How could anyone bear to eat bunny's... afternoon tea?
green-milk-tea: A blend of green tea and milk in the golden ratio, fragrant, refreshing, and an excellent palate cleanser.
green-tea: Brewed from green tea leaves, featuring a vibrant green color and an invigorating effect.
matcha-green-milk-tea: A blend of matcha powder and milk in the golden ratio, slightly more bitter than the green milk tea.
rose-tea: With a few rose buds in the brew, this bright rosy-pink tea has a sweet and fragrant aroma.
cheese-crayfish-stuffed-crab-claws: Savory cheese and fresh seafood, baked to perfection in one pan.
crayfish-avocado-cup: A get-lean diet doesn't have to be all greens. Try avocado with plump, fresh crayfish—a perfectly balanced, deliciously healthy option.
chocolate-mooncake: A delightful fusion of traditional mooncake crust and chocolate—rich, smooth, and wonderfully inventive.
large-chocolate-mooncake: Perfect for sharing with family and friends, this large chocolate mooncake brings everyone together to celebrate the warmth of reunion.
large-egg-yolk-mooncake: A mooncake filled with custard that drips like a lava cake after a hot bite. More mellow compared to original mooncakes.
large-moon-rabbit-snow-skin-mooncake: Plump and chewy snow skin rabbit treats—each bite bursting with delightful flavor.
moon-rabbit-lava-mooncake: Take one bite of the Moon Rabbit Lava Mooncake, and it'll bring tears to your eyes—and water to your mouth.
moon-rabbit-snow-skin-mooncake: The dough was gently kneaded into little rabbits, resting like precious jade on a plate.
mooncake: A traditional pastry, golden and round like a full moon, symbolizing reunion and hope.
osmanthus-roasted-milk-tea: Top pick for fall milk tea! Nothing beats this cup of Osmanthus Roasted Milk Tea that fills the whole room with its aroma.
double-chicken-burger: Whole-cut chicken fillet, double the meat, double the flavor.
saucy-crispy-chicken-wings: Fried to golden perfection and coated in sauce—that's Saucy Crispy.
septuple-king-burger: You must have a pretty strong jaw to take a bite out of this one.
grilled-meat-carrots: What do carrots and grilled meat taste like together? Hold that thought—let your imagination sizzle for a while.
grilled-meat-corn: Sweet corn and smoky grilled meat—a combo that instantly brings the campfire vibe.
grilled-meat-eggplants: Eggplants soak up all those savory juices like a sponge. Only they know how flavorful that journey really was.
grilled-meat-potatoes: Potatoes with grilled meat? By the time you're done, the potatoes usually steal the show.
grilled-meat-tomatoes: Fresh tomatoes cut through the richness with a tangy, juicy burst—perfect for clearing the palate.
grilled-meat-vegetables: Fresh veggies and grilled meat—a match made in heaven that doesn't even ask for cooking skills.
prickly-pear-apple-juice: A prickly pear drink with fresh apples. It brings a taste so refreshing that even ancient folks would've called it a revelation.
prickly-pear-black-garfish-soup: Sweet dates bring out the deep, hidden umami of the fish—like a flavor hook that pulls it right out.
prickly-pear-blueberry-juice: A prickly pear drink with fresh blueberries. It might look like some mysterious ritual potion, but it actually tastes great.
prickly-pear-brown-garfish-soup: A hint of prickly pear tang cuts through the earthy notes—light and bold, perfectly balanced.
prickly-pear-golden-garfish-soup: Golden garfish makes the whole stew look like a fortune in a bowl. One taste, and you can already see the golden glow of deliciousness.
prickly-pear-grape-juice: A prickly pear drink with fresh grapes. Bursting with fruit flavor—so crisp it feels like hitting pause on the heat.
prickly-pear-mandarin-juice: A prickly pear drink with fresh oranges. Tangy and refreshing—so good you'll want another sip before you're done.
prickly-pear-pale-gold-garfish-soup: Firm and springy, this fish holds its shape even after a long cook. It's not just old-school—it's got the texture to back it up.
prickly-pear-pineapple-juice: A prickly pear drink with fresh pineapples. Bright and tangy, it's just right for sipping while watching the sunset on the beach.
prickly-pear-raspberry-juice: A prickly pear drink with fresh raspberries. It's a perfect pick for blazing hot days—a colorful cooler in a glass.
prickly-pear-silver-garfish-soup: Green soup with a fish eye glowing faintly. Safe to drink? Probably.
prickly-pear-strawberry-juice: A prickly pear drink with fresh strawberries. The strawberry pieces play a pretty little pink trick on your eyes.
prickly-pear-fish-soup: Slow-simmered fish soup, creamy and soothing. One sip, and it feels like a warm hug from the inside.
prickly-pear-fruit-juice: A prickly pear drink with fresh fruit. One sip, and it's like finding an oasis in the desert.
primitive-feast-combo: A bunch of people huddled around the campfire, debating what to eat. So ... what's for dinner? How about the Primitive Feast Combo?
qiaogou: A sweet, beautifully shaped pastry from Chi, said to bring nimble fingers to those who eat it.
egg-rice-bowl-banchos-pick: Let the egg rice bowl cool slightly before topping it with sea grapes. That's the secret to keeping it nice and crunchy.
fried-shrimp-sushi-banchos-pick: Deep-fried shrimp sushi, crispy on the outside and springy on the inside—not a second longer in the oil!
cinnamoroll-crepe: Flying Cinnamoroll decides to take a little break on a soft crepe. Hmm ... looks like it's about to drift into a sweet dream.
kuromi-crepe: Kuromi thinks a regular crepe just isn't special enough—two chocolate bars on top? Now that's tasty!
my-melody-crepe: A dessert lover like My Melody, will this yummy crepe win her heart too?
apple-pearl-cake: Did Snow White and the Little Mermaid team up to whip up this cute little cake?
blueberry-pearl-cake: A pearl thief sneaks into the deep sea and swipes six blue pearls ... only to find out five of them are actually blueberries. All that effort, and all they got was a snack.
grilled-squid-w-apple-jam: Fresh squid runs the gauntlet—five rounds, then straight into apple jam.
grilled-squid-w-blueberry-jam: The witch's poison? Nope. Go for blueberry jam and grilled squid. That's the real antidote.
grilled-squid-w-fruit-jam: When a tangy fruit jam enters the chat, the squid never stands a chance.
grilled-squid-w-pineapple-jam: Pineapple jam meets grilled squid—like a gathering of two tropical islanders.
grilled-squid-w-starfruit-jam: The sour-sweet magic of starfruit jam is so wild, even the grilled squid starts seeing stars.
grilled-squid-w-strawberry-jam: It's not just the strawberry jam getting hot under the collar in this heat ... the squid's feeling it too.
mandarin-pearl-cake: That bright, zesty mandarin flavor really knows how to steal the spotlight—even the beautiful pearls can barely compete.
ocean-feast: Ride the breeze and the waves—get ready for a romantic little feast of flavors.
ocean-iced-drink: Why is the ocean iced drink blue? Probably because the starfruit dressed up as a sea star is going blublublu inside!
raspberry-pearl-cake: Two raspberries dressed up as red coral? Honestly, they actually fit right in next to that pearl cake.
seashell-pearl-cake: A little cake that looks almost like a real pearl. The seashell? It's mostly just for decoration.
starfruit-jam: It boasts a bright amber hue, with a sour tang that perfectly cuts through the sweetness of desserts.
starfruit-pearl-cake: The starfruit next to the pearl cake doesn't mind making a little cameo as a sea star.
tomato-seafood-soup: A rich, savory appetizer soup this good—you really think one slice of bread is enough? Better make it two!
pillow-shaped-egg-yolk-pork-zongzi: The hearty, substantial pillow-shaped egg yolk & pork zongzi is packed with generous fillings that satisfy in every bite!
pillow-shaped-plain-rice-zongzi: A soft, fragrant pillow-shaped plain rice zongzi paired with savory sides—a classic choice for savory lovers.
pillow-shaped-red-bean-zongzi: A smooth, creamy pillow-shaped red bean zongzi with a runny center—careful, it's hot!
triangle-egg-yolk-pork-zongzi: A delicate triangle egg yolk & pork zongzi. Can one really be enough?
triangle-plain-rice-zongzi: The crystal-clear triangle plain rice zongzi is best enjoyed hot, dipped in sugar.
triangle-red-bean-zongzi: A triangle red bean zongzi, packed with whole beans. Take your time chewing—don't just swallow it whole.
rainbow-heart: Embrace the rainbow, own the color!
rainbow-spark: Touch the rainbow, feel the spark!
apple-verbena-pie: This is a classic apple pie—no burnt bits, just pure goodness.
blueberry-verbena-pie: Making a blueberry pie... wait, how did the blueberries end up soaking in the cream first?
brick-black-truffle-patty-burger: Deep inside the dark truffle burger, a brick meat patty rests in quiet slumber.
brick-bowl-apple-shaved-ice: On the mountain of shaved ice built from countless tiny brick ice, three brave apple warriors have reached the summit.
brick-bowl-blueberry-shaved-ice: On the mountain of shaved ice built from countless tiny brick ice, a chase unfolds between rival blueberry clans.
brick-bowl-fruit-shaved-ice: Once a towering shaved ice peak, until the day a family of hefty fruits moved in—and things started to get wobbly.
brick-bowl-grape-shaved-ice: At the foot of the mountain of shaved ice built from countless tiny brick ice, grapes join hands to praise the wonders of nature.
brick-bowl-mandarin-shaved-ice: On the mountain of shaved ice built from countless tiny brick ice, the relentless spirit of mandarin slices has painted the slopes gold.
brick-bowl-pineapple-shaved-ice: On the mountain of shaved ice built from countless tiny brick ice, pineapple chunks sit atop a cloud of condensed milk, taking in the view.
brick-bowl-raspberry-shaved-ice: On the mountain of shaved ice built from countless tiny brick ice, a pair of raspberries tie the knot.
brick-bowl-strawberry-shaved-ice: On the mountain of shaved ice built from countless tiny brick ice, a giant strawberry takes the crown!
brick-button-mushroom-patty-burger: Plump little button mushrooms—unexpected heroes that give the patty a lift.
brick-fun-combo-set: The Ultimate Brick Fun Combo Set—mix and match to your heart's content!
brick-mushroom-patty-burger: The hardest part of making a delicious mushroom patty burger? Getting all the layers to stay perfectly stacked.
brick-oyster-mushroom-patty-burger: On an ordinary day, nothing soothes the soul quite like a juicy, savory oyster mushroom patty burger.
brick-penny-bun-patty-burger: The finest ingredients need nothing more than a simple white bun to shine. Don't worry, the penny bun inside is perfectly cooked.
brick-shiitake-patty-burger: That bun color looks a little... off. They didn't sneak any weird shiitake in there, did they?
fruit-verbena-pie: One bite of a fruit flavored pie, and deliciousness loops endlessly in your mouth.
grape-verbena-pie: How to slice it so the grapes on the crust are perfectly divided? Now that's a real question.
mandarin-verbena-pie: A mandarin pie wearing a "pearl necklace"—elegance never goes out of style.
pineapple-verbena-pie: Dig a little hole in the crust, and out blooms a pineapple flower.
raspberry-verbena-pie: Visit Whale Island, wander through the fun Modular Streets, and savor the tangy sweetness of raspberry pie...
strawberry-verbena-pie: What's the best flavor? Hard to say—but the strawberry pie sure looks stunning.
heart-puppies-con-panna: Aww, two little puppies snuggled together in a cup—if you look from afar, they almost form a heart.
maltese-canele: The maltese sitting atop the canelé makes this pastry even more adorable!
maltese-con-panna: Fresh cream shaped like a maltese floats gently on your coffee. A nice combination, isn't it?
caramel-popcorn-bucket: An irresistible caramel aroma evenly coats every kernel, sweet and crunchy.
colorful-movie-combo: Colorful Combo Set—one serving satisfies both sight and taste.
romaine-lettuce-taco: Crisp, juicy leaves encase a hearty filling—healthy, refreshing, and guilt-free.
salsa-wavy-potato-chips: Rippled potato chips paired with salsa—one bite, and your heart will soar!
savory-popcorn-bucket: Bursting with a rich buttery fragrance, the popcorn is crispy and savory.
springdag-raspberry-black-tea: Pure black tea with fresh raspberries, each sip is a quirky springtime fantasy.
springday-apple-black-tea: Pure black tea with fresh apple, pure and simple like a love story.
springday-blueberry-black-tea: Pure black tea with fresh blueberries, a fantasy adventure into the deep sea and dreams.
springday-fruit-black-tea: Pure black tea with fresh fruits—stacked with stars, packed with nutrition.
springday-grape-black-tea: Pure black tea with fresh grapes—softly murmuring, like a tale woven in mist.
springday-mandarin-black-tea: Pure black tea with fresh orange—filled with the sweet-and-sour zest of a coming-of-age story.
springday-pineapple-black-tea: Pure black tea with fresh pineapple—its refreshing taste barrels through like a race car in a road movie.
springday-strawberry-black-tea: Pure black tea with fresh strawberries, a sweet encounter bubbling with pink romance.
supreme-movie-meal: Ultimate Flavor Combo Set—every bite treats you like the main character. Don't worry, the on-screen stars won't reach out and steal your food. Well, usually.
wild-bracken-celtuce-taco: A creative dish that blends rustic flavor with modern light cuisine—packed with greens for a healthy bite!
wild-burdock-celtuce-taco: Hearty, earthy notes with cooling, anti-inflammatory properties. Perfect if you've been feeling a bit "heated" lately.
wild-garlic-mustard-celtuce-taco: Beneath its fresh green exterior rages a "spicy storm" that sweeps across your taste buds.
wild-mustard-greens-celtuce-taco: A flavor-packed "wild" taco with rich layers of texture, best enjoyed with a tangy sauce.
wild-vegetable-celtuce-taco: Celtuce taco filled with fresh wild greens, the top choice for vegetarians.
apple-frosted-pancake: The pancake tower, now clad in a white coat of frosting, tops itself with a cute apple cap.
aurora-banquet: A candlelit meal enjoyed beneath the dazzling aurora—the height of romance.
blueberry-frosted-pancake: A sweet, frosty dusting makes blueberry flowers bloom across the soft pancake base.
creamy-white-radish-soup: Adding smooth, silky cream to a slowly simmered white radish soup is the perfect finishing touch.
iced-cup-coffee: Refreshing and aromatic, but be careful your lips don't get stuck while drinking.
iced-cup-latte: The secret to a latte's rich, smooth texture is a sturdy ice cup that refuses to melt.
mandarin-frosted-pancake: A sweet-tart, juicy orange cap breathes new life into the golden pancake tower.
original-frosted-pancake: A gentle snow of frosting drifts down over the pancake tower kingdom.
raspberry-frosted-pancake: Vibrant, charming raspberries fill the pancake tower kingdom with festive cheer.
steak-w-mashed-white-radish: The refreshing mashed white radish perfectly balances the richness of the steak—a savory delight.
